svg.title: Raspberry Pi 5 ribbon connectors
svg.desc: The two MIPI ribbon connectors on the right edge of the Raspberry Pi 5 as mounted in the case, top to bottom. CAM/DISP 1, the topmost connector nearest the RJ45 port, takes the OV9281 camera ribbon (CSI), configured with dtoverlay=ov9281,cam1. CAM/DISP 0 takes the Touch Display 2 ribbon (DSI), detected automatically. Both connectors take either a camera or a display; the camera overlay must name the connector the camera is actually in.
svg.text: Ribbon connectors · right edge of the Pi, top to bottom
Either connector takes a camera or a display; the camera overlay must name the camera's connector.
